title: ericameria parishii var. peninsularis
intro: Ericameria parishii var. peninsularis, commonly known as Bigberry Cholla, is a variety of shrub in the daisy family that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from pain, inflammation, and fever, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The health benefits of Bigberry Cholla are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, allowing it to effectively reduce swelling, prevent infection, and lower body temperature. The bioactive constituents of Bigberry Cholla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine.
